profile: dot product: A mathematical operation between two vectors that multiplies corresponding components and sums the results. In graph neural networks, it is written as h^(m)T h^(n), representing the dot product between two node embeddings. This value is used as a similarity measure between the embeddings, for example in edge prediction tasks.
